description: For the AI answers where the brand and a competitor are BOTH mentioned, compares who is named higher. One row per tracked competitor: how many answers they co-appear in, how often the brand out-ranks / loses to / ties them (by best mention position), the win rate, the average positions, and one representative shared query. Optionally focus a single competitor via competitorId. Tracked competitors only. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "who wins when we both appear", "do I outrank competitor X", "who is mentioned first".

competitorId.description: optional competitor UUID to focus on a single rival; competitor UUIDs are listed by get_available_filters (competitors[].id)

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode (SERP/Shopping have no AI text mentions)

name: get_competitor_cooccurrence
title: Competitor co-occurrence (head-to-head)
